issues: Whether a termination-without-cause clause limiting termination pay to the ESA statutory minimum is enforceable
Whether an unenforceable for-cause termination clause invalidates a separate without-cause termination clause in the same contract
Whether a for-cause termination clause providing no notice or pay contravenes the ESA's 'wilful misconduct' standard for denial of statutory entitlements
Whether termination provisions must be read together as a whole when assessing ESA compliance
If the termination clause is void, what common law reasonable notice period applies
key_facts: Client has an Ontario employment contract
The contract includes a without-cause termination clause limiting termination pay to the statutory minimum
The contract includes a separate for-cause termination clause purporting to allow dismissal with nothing paid
candidate_statutes: O. Reg. 288/01 (ESA Termination and Severance of Employment)
search_terms: for cause clause void ESA minimum
